nodes.description: Constant address of the Leviathan Whirlpool contract that exposes release().
Constant address of the Whirlpool contract queried for user info.
External view function that reads the Leviathan Whirlpool info and returns the remaining requirement.
External function that triggers release() on the Leviathan Whirlpool contract.
Caller-supplied requirement amount passed to check().
uint256[12] memory array holding the Whirlpool info returned by getAllInfoFor().
Arithmetic subtraction _requirement - userData[10] performed in check().
External call IRelease(_leviathanWhirlpool).release() made in execute() without reentrancy protection.

edges.reason: check() consumes the _requirement parameter supplied by the caller.
check() stores the external getAllInfoFor() return value in the local userData array.
The _whirlpool state variable is the target of the call whose result is written into userData.
_requirement is an operand of the subtraction, so an attacker-controlled value reaches the arithmetic operation.
userData[10] read from the external contract is an operand of the subtraction.
check() controls execution of the subtraction on the else branch and its return value.
The subtraction result is returned by check() to the caller.
execute() unconditionally performs the external release() call.
The _leviathanWhirlpool state variable provides the target address of the release() external call.
release() hands control to an external contract that may re-enter execute() before state settles.

normalization_plan.reason: The _requirement parameter has no independent identity; it belongs to and is only meaningful inside check().
The userData local array exists only to feed userData[10] into the subtraction unsafe operation.
